newsitem.title: ITALY: Saboteurs hit Franco-Italian tunnel test site.
newsitem.headline: Saboteurs hit Franco-Italian tunnel test site.

text.p: Saboteurs set fire to drilling equipment being used in geological studies of a planned new rail tunnel through the Alps between Italy and France, Italian police said on Monday.
A police spokesman in the town of Susa, west of Turin near the border with France, said Sunday's arson attack caused no injuries.
"We estimate the damage at 10 million lire ($6,000)," the spokesman said by telephone.
The French-Italian company Alpetunnel is conducting the studies near Susa as part of a project to provide a high-speed rail link between Turin and the French city of Lyon.
The police spokesman said slogans attacking the project had been written on the wall of an abandoned farmhouse near the scene of the attack, the second of its kind in six months.
Police said they suspected radical environmentalists.
